RG-c3bf21b6df.description: Division may fail when the divisor is zero
RG-c3bf21b6df.rationale: The divisor is a variable and this expression does not establish a non-zero precondition.

LLM-a2b805be40.description: Using eval on untrusted input allows code injection
LLM-a2b805be40.rationale: eval will execute any Python code supplied in the expression, leading to arbitrary code execution

RG-baa36383e0.description: Use of eval can execute attacker-controlled Python
RG-baa36383e0.rationale: Dynamic code execution is unsafe when any part of the expression is untrusted.
RG-baa36383e0.suggested_fix:
return ast.literal_eval(expression)
# import ast; literal_eval accepts only Python literals. For arithmetic, parse with ast and allow only number and operator nodes.

LLM-add14d26f3.rationale: If count is zero, the function raises a ZeroDivisionError, causing a crash or denial of service.
